import sys, numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from te.algorithms.formulations.path_based.distributed.coordinator import Coordinator
c=Coordinator(1, 1.0, 1.5)
c.load_state({'Z':np.array([4.0]),'Z_old':np.array([4.0]),'dual':np.array([1.0]),'rho':1.0,'iterate':0})
z,u,h,t=c.step(np.array([2.0]), np.array([True]), 'route')
print('route', z, u, h, t)
assert abs(z[0]-1)<1e-12 and abs(u[0]-1)<1e-12 and abs(h-1)<1e-12 and abs(t[0]-1)<1e-12
c2=Coordinator(2, 2.0, 1.5)
c2.load_state({'Z':np.array([4.0,-3.0]),'Z_old':np.array([4.0,-3.0]),'dual':np.array([1.0,0.5]),'rho':2.0,'iterate':0})
z,u,h,t=c2.step(np.array([2.0,1.0]), np.array([True,False]), 'route')
print('two-edge', z,u,h,t)
# edge1 withdrawn -> all zeros there
assert z[1]==0 and u[1]==0 and t[1]==0
# hand check edge 0: V = 1.5*2 + (-0.5)*4 + 1 = 2 ; rho=2: h = (2 - 0.5)/1 = 1.5 ; z=1.5 ; t=2*(2-1.5)=1 ; u=1+3-2-1.5=0.5
assert abs(z[0]-1.5)<1e-12 and abs(t[0]-1)<1e-12 and abs(u[0]-0.5)<1e-12, (z,u,t,h)
# admit
c3=Coordinator(2, 2.0, 3/2)
c3.load_state({'Z':np.array([4.0,0.0]),'Z_old':np.array([4.0,0.0]),'dual':np.array([1.0,0.0]),'rho':2.0,'iterate':0})
z,u,h,t=c3.step(np.array([2.0,0.0]), np.array([True,True]), 'admit')
print('admit', z,u,h,t)
# V0 = 3-2+1=2 -> z=min(2,1)=1, t=2*(2-1)=2 ; V1=0+0+0=0 -> z=0,t=0
assert abs(h-1)<1e-15 and abs(z[0]-1)<1e-12 and abs(t[0]-2)<1e-12 and z[1]==0 and t[1]==0
assert abs(u[0]-(1+3-2-1))<1e-12 and abs(u[1]-0)<1e-12
print('coordinator hand checks ok')
PYEOF
